# MedRAG Dataset

This folder contains the dataset resources used in the SmartCare Copilot MedRAG pipeline.

## Automatically Generated File

**`AI Data Set with Categories.csv`** is not uploaded to GitHub because of its large size.

This file is automatically generated by running `preprocess_ddxplus.py` in the `Preprocessing` folder, using the required DDXPlus source files.

The generated CSV is then used by `training.py` to prepare patient records for the retrieval database.
